title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode12 Emu's Dream

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, dynamism is the most important in the next scene. Unleash your full power! Raise your legs as high as you can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Urgh! This split is literally going to split me!
Don't fail me now, my star body!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You want me to teach you to sing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh huh! I have a strong voice but Tsukasa always complains about my singing!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Okay, fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You'll teach me?! Thanks, Robo-Nene!
I'll show you what I can do so far. Wonder wander yonder hoy hoy〜♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe... What on earth are you trying to sing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The seats need to be repaired so that our audience won't be distracted from our performances by squeaky, wobbly benches!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May I suggest rigging the seats so that they can be moved as part of the show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh, I know what you mean!
Like gatagatagata-pshhh! Thomp! Whap! Kaa-ching! Right? That'd be so fun♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Guys, let's keep it real...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that's all, folks! We hope you enjoyed our show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perfect. Dress rehearsal was excellent.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Excellent” is my middle name! Ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sooo excited for the actual show!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With the park mascots helping us advertise the event, we should see a good number of people turn up. And Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to implement all of my stage directions. Thank you. Working with you has been a true pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a bit early to be saying that, we're not finished yet! The real show will be ten million times better than our best rehearsal!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Where are you pulling those numbers from? But yes, I'm also hoping that the public performance will turn out fabulous.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, it will!
It will be the first step on my journey towards stardom!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Don't you ever get tired boasting about that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Criticism doesn't faze me! I have a good feeling about this stage. It makes my star senses tingle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, Nene, and Emu. It must have been difficult for you to keep up with me, but you've done well. Our show tomorrow is certain to be a smash hit!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I don't remember trying to “keep up” with you.
...It doesn't matter. I hope our audience enjoys the play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I also wanted to thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For what? You're looking uncharacteristically serious...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's my dream to have people come to see a show here at this stage and love it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you've been strangely attached to this stage from the start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, it looks like tomorrow my dream will come true! Thank you sooo much for making it possible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Obviously you were unable to put on a decent show until a star such as myself showed up. Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: His ego just keeps growing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, no harm done. Shall we call it a day?
We've got an early start tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's go home! See you here tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And when Prince Pegasus comes over my way, I turn and say my line.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Please allow me to take care of this.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then I sing. I've remembered all the steps.
But maybe I should rehearse one more time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey. I had a feeling you'd still be here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: C-Can't I have some privacy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The show's tomorrow.
I wanted to make sure you weren't overexerting yourself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I...have to make sure I don't make any mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I wouldn't want you to make mistakes either, so I'm offering to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case, can we go over the scene where I sing to put the dragon to sleep? I think I need to practice it a bit more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was perfect. You have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It'll be nice if the audience likes it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be going now. I have to get some rest to be ready for tomorrow's performance. Don't stay too long, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I should vary the tempo more in the last song...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess I'll leave her to it.)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The big day's tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What's this feeling? I'm strangely wired...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It can't be...anxiety?! No, that wouldn't affect ME!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I must just be excited for tomorrow's show.
The day of the show

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Clear skies, no rain forecast! The audience seats are full! We're poised for success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! So many people came to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. That's heartening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? Why so quiet today, robot?
Don't tell me you've got stage fright?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't be silly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Listen, everyone's eyes will be on me! No one's going to bother paying attention to some weird robot, so you need not worry about messing up! Ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Tsk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think that might just be his way of encouraging you.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: No, I'm sure he totally believes it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's put on an amazing show today!
One, two...We can do wonders, wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui & Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Guys, my energy levels dropped just hearing that!
Watch me, this is how you do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime, it's time to raise the curtain!
